# movestrongfit.com

> US Manufacturer of custom and specialty functional fitness training equipment for indoor and outdoor settings. Gym design and layout services for turn-key fitness and obstacle course projects designed for health clubs, fitness studios, schools, Parks, and military.



## Home

- [MoveStrong Functional Fitness | Indoor/Outdoor Custom Training Equipment, Fitness Space Design](https://movestrongfit.com/): US Manufacturer of custom and specialty functional fitness training equipment for indoor and outdoor settings. Gym design and layout services for turn-key fitness and obstacle course projects designed for health clubs, fitness studios, schools, Parks, and military.

## Key Facts

- Company: MoveStrong
- Founded: 1990
- Headquarters: United States
- Manufacturer of commercial-grade functional fitness equipment
- Products are designed and manufactured in the USA (if accurate)
- Provides custom fitness space design and layout planning
- Serves customers throughout North America and internationally
- Installation guidance and layout planning available
- Products are available for indoor, outdoor, and mixed-use environments

## Productnews

- [Built for Progression: Introducing Gravity Indoor Calisthenics Training Systems - MoveStrong](https://movestrongfit.com/productnews/2026/10/3/built-for-progression-introducing-gravity-indoor-calisthenics-systems): Discover MoveStrong Gravity Indoor, a purpose-built calisthenics system designed for commercial gyms, training facilities, schools, and campus fitness centers. Explore flexible bodyweight training stations and layouts designed to help athletes build strength, control, and movement skills.
- [Introducing MoveStrong Gravity Outdoor: Purpose-Built Calisthenics Training Systems - MoveStrong](https://movestrongfit.com/productnews/2026/9/13/introducing-movestrong-gravity-calisthenics-systems): MoveStrong® Gravity is a new addition to the outdoor product range, bringing purpose-built commercial calisthenics equipment to outdoor environments. Designed for progressive training, Gravity supports users from fundamental bodyweight movements through advanced strength, control and skill development.
- [Move. Connect. Grow. Introducing MoveStrong Movement Commons - MoveStrong](https://movestrongfit.com/productnews/2026/9/13/introducing-movestrong-movement-commons): MoveStrong is expanding its outdoor product range with MoveStrong Movement Commons™, a new approach to creating outdoor destinations designed for movement, fitness and connection. Combining fitness, calisthenics, climbing, balance, obstacles, mobility and recreational movement, Movement Commons creates customized outdoor environments with more ways to move, train, gather and connect.
- [A New Route for Upper-Body Strength Riser Parallel Bar Walk - MoveStrong](https://movestrongfit.com/productnews/2026/8/17/riser-parallel-bar-walk): The Riser Parallel Bar Walk is a compact Warrior Edition obstacle that challenges upper-body strength, body control, and technique as athletes navigate a central dip.
